senses.definition: n.pr.loc. in Benj.;—גֵּי הצ׳ (perhaps valley of hyenas, so Thes, cf. LagBN 36 Grayl.c.);—1 S 13:18 (according to BuhlGeogr. 98 = Wady el-Kelt, between Jerus. and Jericho), Σαμειν, 𝔊L Σαβαιν; cf. צ׳ Ne 11:34, A Σεβοειμ, 𝔊L Σεβωειν.
